old_paragraph: In Paint, two gestures entered one image. Here the image and the body encounter different accounts of the same wall. Let that disagreement stay visible. An invitation to look is not yet an invitation to enter. Perhaps the useful discovery is the doorway; perhaps it is the distinction that lets you ask for another kind of doorway.
new_paragraph: In Paint, two gestures entered one image. Here the image and the body encounter different accounts of the same wall. Through the glass, you can see the desk from the aisle and the aisle from the desk. Opacity interrupts that view in both directions. The cubicle offers another degree of privacy without another way out.
insertions: Press once more. The furniture returns to view. No doorway has opened.

![The same furnished cubicle viewed through glass and opaque partitions.](/book-review/doc/book/iterations/2026-09-23-walls-view-and-passage/same-opening.png)

*The view changes; the opening stays. Both states send the body through the same doorway.*
A colour has become an address again, but the address now comes from the colour itself.

![The museum’s RGB cube and HSV cylinder, each displaying five hundred colour samples.](/book-review/doc/book/iterations/2026-09-23-walls-view-and-passage/colour-coordinates.png)

*RGB channels become three straight directions. In HSV, hue goes around, saturation moves outward and value changes height.*
The middle changes. The agreement about where to begin and end did not decide how to travel.

![The same sixteen gradient cubes between red and blue in RGB and HSV modes.](/book-review/doc/book/iterations/2026-09-23-walls-view-and-passage/same-endpoints.png)

*The endpoints remain red and blue. Changing the interpolation changes the colours encountered between them.*

sequence_transition.old_paragraph: A view through glass, a position in a colour model, a calculated passage: similar appearances can conceal different operations. Carry that habit of asking how into the chamber ahead. When colour and shape both change, which operation did your gesture actually set in motion?
sequence_transition.new_paragraph: A view through glass, a position in a colour model, a calculated passage: similar appearances can conceal different operations. Ahead, the disco floor returns in colour. Keep its arrangement and change its palette. Does the same pattern still invite the same movement?
